title: Ensure repository creation is limited to specific members
description: Every new repository starts outside the review of whoever governs the existing ones. On Azure DevOps, "Create repository" is its own permission, held by default only by Project Administrators; this control lists, per project, the people who hold it without administering the project. Organization administrators are counted by CIS-1.3.3 instead.
remediation: Project settings -> Repositories -> All Repositories -> Security, in each listed project: set "Create repository" to Not set for the users and groups listed, leaving it with Project Administrators. A grant made for the organization's Git repositories as a whole applies to every project, so check it there too. Adjust how many non-administrators may hold it per project with thresholds.maxRepositoryCreators in azure-devops-bench's config.
fixSummary: Remove "Create repository" at Project settings -> Repositories -> All Repositories -> Security.
